# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 18 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 18 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**18:1** [...] for the wicked [...] snares of wickedness [...]

**18:2** [...] and in their council of deceit they plotted against me [...]

**18:3** [...] they sealed every source of understanding and withheld the drink of knowledge.

**18:4** And for their thirst [...] they gaze upon their folly [...]

**18:5** [...] at their feasts [...] for they set [...]

**18:6** [...] they have banished me from my land like a bird from its nest,

**18:7** and all my companions and friends have been driven from me.

**18:8** They regard me as a broken vessel; they -- interpreters of lies and seers of deceit --

**18:9** devised against me a scheme of Belial, to exchange Your instruction,

**18:10** which You engraved upon my heart, for smooth things to Your people.

**18:11** They withheld the drink of knowledge from the thirsty, and for their thirst

**18:12** they give them vinegar to drink. [...] their wickedness [...]

**18:13** [...] gates of affliction admitting no escape [...] instruments of war [...]

**18:14** [...] a bar upon my bones [...] like a ship in the fury of [...]

**18:15** [...] they roar like the waves of the sea. [...] counselors of deceit [...]

**18:16** [...] the scheme [...] closing in around me.

**18:17** My soul within me grows faint [...] for my strength has departed from my flesh,

**18:18** my heart pours out like water, my flesh melts like wax,

**18:19** and the power of my loins has turned to fear, my arm is torn from its socket.

**18:20** I cannot [...] for the hostility admits no remedy, and rebuke burns [...]

**18:21** [...] I cannot [...] my pain [...] a sickness unto death [...]

**18:22** [...] yet they [...] they rejoice [...] upon me [...]

**18:23** [...] my arm [...] my foot sinks in the mire.

**18:24** [...] the snares of wickedness have enclosed me [...] and nets [...]

**18:25** But You, O God, [...] You have placed my soul in the bundle of the living,

**18:26** and You have shielded me from every snare of the pit. Violent men

**18:27** have sought my soul, but they did not prevail when You strengthened my heart

**18:28** and came to my aid. By Your covenant-faithfulness [...] and the abundance of Your mercies

**18:29** You have strengthened my standing, and in the greatness of Your forgiveness [...] You did not cast me off,

**18:30** and in the time of my soul's anguish You did not abandon me.

**18:31** [...] my cry [...] to my groaning You gave an answer of consolation,

**18:32** and I have rejoiced in forgiveness, and I am comforted concerning the former transgression.

**18:33** I know that hope rests in Your covenant-faithfulness and trust in the abundance of Your might,

**18:34** for no one is justified without Your good pleasure, and no one [...] apart from Your will.

**18:35** [...] You teach all knowledge, and everything that exists is by Your will.

**18:36** There is no other beside You to reply to Your counsel, to understand

**18:37** all Your holy purpose, to gaze into the depths of Your mysteries, or to comprehend all Your wonders.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Column 18 is heavily damaged but preserves a powerful lament-to-consolation arc. SOPHIA adopted EMET's "bundle of the living" for tzeror ha-chayyim. "Covenant-faithfulness" per project convention. See disagreement log for 7 divergences.*
